reviews.quote: Priced well for an upper-mid-tier device with a gorgeous display and solid performance — creators will love this laptop's flexible form factor and impressive battery life.

praises: 2TB + 32GB for $1,799 sale — cheapest big-storage convertible in Canada
Big 16" touch canvas with full ports incl. HDMI + 2x USB-A
Quiet fans; 155U barely heats during office work
Numeric keypad praised by spreadsheet users
Only $100 over the 1TB tier — storage upgrade nearly free
complaints: Heavy (~2 kg) and thick for a convertible — tablet mode is a token feature
155U trails Ryzen AI and H-class chips in pricier rivals
Base WUXGA 60Hz glossy panel: average brightness, reflections
Chassis flex and hinge wobble on the big 16" deck
Regular price $2,339 is notional — only the sales are real

design_philosophy: Same big-screen family-convertible formula as the 1TB tier, pushed to 2TB storage for media-librarian households; the +$100 sale delta makes this the rational pick of the Envy x360 16 range.
